title: Any Nix package, live in your browser
summary: Any Nix package, live in your browser Farid Zakaria calls this his " magnum opus of Nix work", and I can see why. trynix.dev provides a qemu-wasm powered x86_64 Linux virtual machine running entirely in your browser through WebAssembly. That VM can then be booted with any Nix pac
reason: Item covers a Nix-on-WebAssembly browser VM, not an AI model, research, industry, or policy event, and it is not an AI open-source project or developer tool. It also links to a third-party blog rather than the repository, release page, docs, or official write-up, so no active rule covers it.
